description: Calendar (ICS) events and free slots — Read an iCalendar feed and list its events in a time window with recurring series expanded. Pass url= (an .ics or webcal link, such as a Google, Outlook or Apple calendar secret address) or text= (ICS content). Expands RRULE DAILY/WEEKLY/MONTHLY/YEARLY with INTERVAL, COUNT, UNTIL, BYDAY (incl. 2MO, -1FR), BYMONTHDAY, BYMONTH, BYSETPOS, plus EXDATE, RDATE and moved instances (RECURRENCE-ID); skips cancelled events; handles TZID (incl. Windows zone names), floating and all-day times. Optional: from (YYYY-MM-DD, default today), days (1-92, default 14) or to (YYYY-MM-DD), tz (IANA output zone; default the calendar X-WR-TIMEZONE, else UTC), q (keyword filter), limit (default 200). free=1 adds open meeting slots inside work_start..work_end (default 09:00-17:00 weekdays; weekends=1, min_minutes default 30). Returns events with UTC and local times, busy minutes per day, double-booking conflicts and the next event. Price: $0.004 USDC (Base, via x402).
